informal_statement: Issue #287 SR3 with both ledgers derived from the same twist steps: the orientation ledger Delta S = 2 e_p.e_q does not predict contraction of the separation r = x_A - x_B. By the parallelogram law the mean growth of |r|^2 is 2 - Delta S, so binding (opposite) steps push apart on average and like steps hold the separation fixed.
